title: Tree Basics
definition: A Tree is a non-linear data structure consisting of nodes connected by edges, forming a hierarchy. The topmost node is the Root, and nodes without children are Leaves.
simpleExplanation: An organization chart where the CEO is at the top, managers are in the middle, and regular employees are at the bottom.
